title: PES - Pandemic Emergency Scenario
description: EEG dataset from a complex, strategic decision-making pandemic emergency scenario in which nine participants, paired with an artificial agent, allocated limited resources (medicines, personnel) to cities shown on a map. Participants reported their confidence in each decision across 64 sequences. Recordings combine 64-channel EEG with ECG and EOG channels and behavioural responses, supporting research on decision making, confidence and human-machine teaming.
methods_description: Participants sat about 1 m from an LCD monitor and wore a Biosemi ActiveTwo EEG cap with 64 wet electrodes in the international 10-20 system, plus eight external channels (two ECG, four EOG). Data were sampled at 2048 Hz. On each trial participants had 10 s to set the resource allocation with mouse press, drag and release. They then had 5 s to report confidence with the mouse wheel. Finally the other players' responses were shown for 2 s.
